title: Mansarovar Pearl Gardens
description: It’s time to start living the best life. Exploring new horizons of living with best in class amenities. It’s time to take the plunge and focus on living the best possible life exclusively at Pearl Gardens, located in Vasai West, Om Nagar. Imagine living at a location that is well connected with local markets, schools, hospitals, banks, transportation, multiplex, restaurant’s etc. along with 40+ amenities at your disposal.
